name: sourcebraid
description: Search, fetch, index, and safely manage a private SourceBraid Markdown archive using a local Python runtime in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Search your private Markdown knowledge archive.
interface.longDescription: Search and fetch saved Markdown sources from a private GitHub archive in Codex, maintain a local full-text index, and safely preview and delete clips. Requires Python 3 and local GitHub authentication. The hosted read-only ChatGPT connection is a separate distribution.
defaultPrompt: Search my SourceBraid archive for dynamic agents.
Find and summarize my saved sources about AI workflows.
Safely preview deletion of a saved SourceBraid source.
